summary: The old damerau_levenshtein computes restricted optimal string alignment distance, returning 3 for "ca" → "abc" instead of 2. The fix retains that implementation as osa_distance and adds an unrestricted algorithm tracking previous character occurrences. The added test detects this distinction. Planning is blocked under the required verbatim reversal rules: transplanting the parent function would duplicate implementation lines preserved unchanged under osa_distance, violating the changed-lines constraint. Reversing the rename and removing the new function requires separate regions; a contiguous region would include upstream doctests. No builds or tests were run.
